_readme: Golden retrieval questions: does find_topic still surface the right course material? scripts/retrieval_eval.py sends each question through the app's real find_topic (same collections, same embedder, same ranking) and passes it when the regex matches the lecture_title, source or text of one of the top within_top results. Expectations are regexes over content, never chunk ids, so a re-index fails the eval only when retrieval quality really changed. These questions match the example course in knowledge-base/raw/; write your own (10 to 50 questions a student would actually ask, each with a regex on words your material really uses) when you replace it. Run: python -m pipeline index --rebuild, then python scripts/retrieval_eval.py. It exits 0 when the pass rate reaches pass_threshold.
